title: chrysanthellum americanum
intro: Chrysanthellum americanum, commonly known as American chamomilla or yellow chamomile, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. The health benefits of Chrysanthellum americanum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, relieve anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Chrysanthellum americanum include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
